label: HISTORICAL SIMULATION 2013-2026: ALADIN 1's walk-forward (out-of-sample) scores, stocks listed today (flatters the positive signals), the price goal is a volatility proxy. Not live trading, not real money.

rules.books: Friday book, positive-signal names only (long-only cash equity)
rules.entry: open of the next trading day
rules.exit_order: the stop, or the open of the 5th trading day after entry (the price goal is information, not an order)
rules.costs: full delivery cost model at the stock's liquidity decile

rule_history.why_dropped: a take-profit at the 50% range edge cut the winners (average win +2.3%) and left the losers (average loss -3.8%)

rule_history.exits: stop + time (the price goal is information only)
rule_history.why: no live trade existed yet, so the live record is untouched

benchmark.label: equal-weight average of the liquid stocks each signal week, compounded, before costs (the same weeks, the same holding period)
